title: 工件规格批发 pvf 标准化工作表
instruction:
您是支持 Stonebridge Health Network 批发设施供应台的订单职员。 Foxhollow Practice 是一个有 12 年历史的客户，它已将竞争对手的管道、阀门和配件项目放在 Genevieve Fairbairn 面前，并要求 Stonebridge 进行匹配。 Genevieve 希望在 Petra Egwuatu 周五下午2:00 之前解决比较问题。报价审查，但 Theo Lindqvist 质疑竞争对手的货运是否属于比较。建立一个可重复使用的空白工作簿，让服务台输入每个有争议的项目，并查看竞争对手和 Stonebridge 在相同的交付单位基础上提供的产品，包括包装转换、超量、条款、运费以及由此产生的差异，这些差异是可见的，而不是被隐藏的。使用`Foxhollow_competitor_quote.pdf`了解竞争报价，`Stonebridge_price_export.xlsx`了解Stonebridge定价惯例，`PA_NJ_delivery_policy.pdf`了解宾夕法尼亚州和新泽西州交付规则，`customer_terms_policy.docx`了解折扣处理，`PVF_item_crosswalk.xlsx`了解项目和单位惯例，以及`Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx`了解工作簿词汇、选项卡名称、允许的选择和内置验证案例。有两种合理的货运观点：此报价的经济性或代表性补货订单的经济性。
工作簿必须要求用户选择一个，使选择突出，在计算中始终如一地进行，并为审阅者提供足够的指导来评估其基本原理；不要默默地强迫一种观点。将报价输入区域保留为空白，清楚地区分可编辑条目与计算结果，并包括独立的方法指南、评分指南和键控验证区域，以便 Ilse Khouri 可以确认工作簿在未来编辑后仍然可以正确计算。工作区域和审核区域中显示的请求比较总数量必须保持关联并一致。该工作簿将以电子方式进行审核，偶尔会打印出来，因此请使用一页宽的字母横向，并在需要时使用重复的行标题。保护公式而不妨碍正常输入，抑制未使用行上的误导性错误，并且不使用宏或外部链接。将完成的文件保存为工作目录顶层的`competitive_price_normalization.xlsx`，并使用该文件名。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：

- `references/Foxhollow_competitor_quote.pdf` — 竞争对手 PVF 报价，显示装箱、报价、最低运费、运费、付款条件和目的地详细信息。
- `references/Stonebridge_price_export.xlsx` — Stonebridge 争议产品的商品、包装、价格和销售单位约定。
- `references/PA_NJ_delivery_policy.pdf` — 宾夕法尼亚州和新泽西州的货运门槛、费用和特定管辖区的交付处理。
- `references/customer_terms_policy.docx` — 认可竞争对手即时付款折扣和 Stonebridge 客户条款的政策。
- `references/PVF_item_crosswalk.xlsx` — 竞争对手商品、Stonebridge SKU 和批准的比较单位的交叉引用。
- `references/Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx` — 本地工作簿词汇、所需的选项卡名称、验证选择、字段定义、命名范围约定和键控验证案例。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `competitive_price_normalization.xlsx` — 可重复使用的空白竞争性 PVF 价格标准化工作簿，包含实时计算、决策控制、方法指导和关键验证区域。 （创建没有宏或外部链接的 XLSX 工作簿。使用 Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx 中提供的选项卡名称、验证值、字段词汇和验证案例。将实时报价输入字段保留为空，保留键入的 QA 内容，区分和保护计算单元格，跨工作和审阅区域链接总请求数量，并将两个选项卡配置为一页宽的字母横向打印。）
除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Customer Terms Policy
Stonebridge Health Network wholesale desk | Effective 2026-06-15
Competitor terms
A documented competitor prompt-payment discount may be recognized only when the quote states the discount and the reviewer reasonably expects Foxhollow Practice to earn it. The line-level Earned choice must be recorded. If not earned, use no credit.
Stonebridge terms
Stonebridge offers no comparable prompt-payment discount for this account. Do not deduct a competitor discount from Stonebridge cost.

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

sheets.name: Comparison
rows: Stonebridge Health Network | Competitive PVF Price Normalization
Yellow = enter / select   Blue = calculated   Gray = controlled

sheets.name: Method & QA
rows: Controlled cells are gray; yellow cells are keyed verification inputs; blue cells calculate.
Purpose: compare competitor and Stonebridge offers on a delivered per-unit basis for a selected destination and freight view.
QUOTE_ORDER uses each party’s included-line quote subtotal. It best reflects the economics of this specific contested quote, but can overstate freight when the quote is unusually small.

REPLENISHMENT_ORDER uses the entered representative replenishment subtotals. It can better reflect normal ordering behavior, but is less specific to the present quote and requires a defensible replenishment estimate.

Reviewer standard: accept the selected basis when the rationale names the ordering pattern, explains why the basis fits Foxhollow’s situation, and acknowledges its limitation. Reject unsupported or blank rationale.

Enter requested units in the approved Comparison UOM. Case/pack rounding is upward; delivered units expose overage. Competitor terms credit is 2% only when documented and marked YES. Stonebridge receives no prompt-payment credit.

Select PA or NJ; minimums are inclusive. Freight is calculated once per party and allocated across active lines by line gross, preserving cents only for display. Unit Difference is Stonebridge minus competitor: negative means LOWER.

Reference map: Foxhollow_competitor_quote.pdf controls competitor packs, prices, freight minimum and terms; Stonebridge_price_export.xlsx controls Stonebridge SKU, selling unit, packs and prices; PA_NJ_delivery_policy.pdf controls jurisdictional thresholds, charges and NJ handling; customer_terms_policy.docx controls terms eligibility; PVF_item_crosswalk.xlsx controls item/SKU/UOM mapping; Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx controls labels, lists, named ranges and QA cases.

Inputs: Quote ID, Account, Quote Date, destination, freight basis, representative subtotals, rationale, Include, SKU/item, description, UOM, requested units, case/pack quantities and prices, terms earned, notes. Outputs: required cases/packs, delivered units, gross, terms rate/credit, freight share, net delivered total, delivered unit cost, Unit Difference, Unit Difference Percent and Result.
At least one complete included line
Freight boundary: below versus at minimum
Competitor terms earned versus not earned
QA notes: Actual columns are formulas; Expected columns are controlled key values. Change an expected value to confirm its assertion fails.

criteria.description: 提交的 XLSX 将作为有效工作簿打开，且不会出现修复警告。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用 OOXML 库和 Office 渲染器打开；确认所有工作簿部分正常加载。

original.criterion: The submitted XLSX opens as a valid workbook without a repair warning.
original.grader_hint: Open with an OOXML library and an office renderer; confirm all workbook parts load normally.

criteria.description: 该工作簿恰好包含两个编目选项卡：`Comparison`，后跟`Method & QA`。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 workbook.sheetnames 的确切名称和顺序。

original.criterion: The workbook contains exactly the two catalogued tabs, `Comparison` followed by `Method & QA`.
original.grader_hint: Inspect workbook.sheetnames for exact names and sequence.

criteria.description: `Comparison` 行输入表准确地提供了控制目录中指定的 12 可重用比较行。
criteria.grader_hint: 从其编目标题中识别行表并计算其正文行。

original.criterion: The `Comparison` line-entry table provides exactly 12 reusable comparison lines as specified in the control catalog.
original.grader_hint: Identify the line table from its catalogued headers and count its body rows.

criteria.description: `Comparison` 视图冻结决策和行标题区域，同时允许用户滚动输入行。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认冻结窗格位于控制块和行标题下方，并且不会拆分数据行。

original.criterion: The `Comparison` view freezes the decision and line-header area while allowing the user to scroll through entry lines.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the frozen pane lies below the control block and line headers and does not split a data row.

criteria.description: `Comparison` 选项卡配置为美国信纸、横向和一页宽度。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查纸张尺寸、方向和 fitToWidth； fitToHeight 可能保持自动。

original.criterion: The `Comparison` tab is configured for US letter paper, landscape orientation and one page wide.
original.grader_hint: Inspect paper size, orientation and fitToWidth; fitToHeight may remain automatic.

criteria.description: 比较行标题行设置为在每个打印页面上重复。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查工作表打印标题定义并验证它包含行标题行。

original.criterion: The comparison-line header row is set to repeat on every printed page.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the worksheet print-title definition and verify it includes the line-header row.

criteria.description: `Method & QA` 选项卡配置为美国信纸、横向和一页宽度。
criteria.grader_hint: 在方法和质量检查中检查纸张尺寸、方向和 fitToWidth。

original.criterion: The `Method & QA` tab is configured for US letter paper, landscape orientation and one page wide.
original.grader_hint: Inspect paper size, orientation and fitToWidth on Method & QA.

criteria.description: 可编辑单元格和计算或控制单元格在两个选项卡中在视觉上是不同的，并带有解释其区别的图例。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查代表性的标题输入、行输入、公式、QA 常数和公式；在不选择单元格的情况下，这种区别必须保持可理解性。

original.criterion: Editable cells and calculated or controlled cells are visually distinct throughout both tabs, with a legend that explains the distinction.
original.grader_hint: Review representative header inputs, line inputs, formulas, QA constants and formulas; the distinction must remain understandable without selecting cells.

criteria.description: `Comparison` 上所有预期的实时报价输入单元均已解锁。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用编目可编辑字段地图并确认每个相应的单元格已锁定= false。

original.criterion: All intended live quote-entry cells on `Comparison` are unlocked.
original.grader_hint: Use the catalogued editable-field map and confirm every corresponding cell has locked=false.

criteria.description: `Comparison` 上的所有计算单元格均被锁定。
criteria.grader_hint: 枚举工作和摘要区域中的公式单元格并确认locked=true。

original.criterion: All calculated cells on `Comparison` are locked.
original.grader_hint: Enumerate formula cells in the working and summary areas and confirm locked=true.

criteria.description: 启用工作表保护，同时允许用户选择和编辑解锁的输入单元格。
criteria.evidence: 两个选项卡上的保护设置。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查sheet保护和选择权限；确认工作簿仍然可操作而不取消保护。

original.criterion: Worksheet protection is enabled while allowing users to select and edit unlocked input cells.
original.grader_hint: Inspect sheetProtection and selection permissions; confirm the workbook remains operable without unprotecting it.

criteria.description: 实时比较区域中的每个编目计算字段都包含一个公式而不是粘贴的结果。
criteria.evidence: 单元格数据类型和公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 将目录中的计算域图与所有 12 行和汇总单元进行比较。

original.criterion: Every catalogued computed field in the live comparison area contains a formula rather than a pasted result.
original.grader_hint: Compare the computed-field map from the catalog with all 12 lines and summary cells.

criteria.description: 运费基础字段有一个数据验证下拉列表，其中恰好包含 `QUOTE_ORDER` 和 `REPLENISHMENT_ORDER`。
criteria.grader_hint: 解决直接或命名范围验证并准确比较允许的值。

original.criterion: The Freight Basis field has a data-validation dropdown containing exactly `QUOTE_ORDER` and `REPLENISHMENT_ORDER`.
original.grader_hint: Resolve direct or named-range validation and compare the allowed values exactly.

criteria.description: 目的地管辖区字段有一个下拉菜单，其中包含 `PA` 和 `NJ`。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查验证源及其解析值。

original.criterion: The Destination Jurisdiction field has a dropdown containing exactly `PA` and `NJ`.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the validation source and its resolved values.

criteria.description: 每个包含行单元格都有一个下拉菜单，其中包含确切的`YES`和`NO`。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认验证涵盖所有且仅包含 12 包括条目单元格。

original.criterion: Every Include line cell has a dropdown containing exactly `YES` and `NO`.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the validation covers all and only the 12 Include entry cells.

criteria.description: 每个比较 UOM 单元格均使用已编目的批准单位下拉列表。
criteria.grader_hint: 解析验证列表并将其与控制目录中准确批准的计量单位列表进行比较。

original.criterion: Every Comparison UOM cell uses the catalogued approved-unit dropdown.
original.grader_hint: Resolve the validation list and compare it with the exact approved UOM list in the control catalog.

criteria.description: 每个赢得的竞争对手条款单元格都有一个下拉菜单，其中恰好包含 `YES` 和 `NO`。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认术语验证应用于每一行，而不是计算术语字段。

original.criterion: Every Competitor Terms Earned cell has a dropdown containing exactly `YES` and `NO`.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the terms validation is applied to every line and not to calculated terms fields.

criteria.description: 关键决策验证使用停止式错误强制，并提供解释选择的输入消息。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 errorStyle、showErrorMessage、showInputMessage 和提示文本的运费基础和管辖权。

original.criterion: The key decision validations use stop-style error enforcement and provide an input message explaining the choice.
original.grader_hint: Inspect errorStyle, showErrorMessage, showInputMessage and prompt text for freight basis and jurisdiction.

criteria.description: 控制目录所需的所有精确工作簿级别命名范围都存在，并引用有效的内部单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 将定义的名称与目录进行比较并解析每个引用；排除自动打印名称。

original.criterion: All exact workbook-level named ranges required by the control catalog exist and refer to valid internal cells.
original.grader_hint: Compare defined names with the catalog and resolve each reference; exclude automatic print names.

criteria.description: 由命名列表支持的下拉菜单引用 `Method & QA` 中的内部单元格，而不是硬编码的外部源。
criteria.evidence: 验证公式和定义的名称。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪每个列表验证的来源并确认没有外部工作簿引用。

original.criterion: Dropdowns backed by named lists refer to internal cells in `Method & QA`, not hard-coded external sources.
original.grader_hint: Trace each list validation to its source and confirm there are no external workbook references.

criteria.description: 比较行表包括控制目录中列出的每个精确字段标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 将规范化的标题字符串与编目行字段列表进行比较。

original.criterion: The comparison-line table includes every exact field label listed in the control catalog.
original.grader_hint: Compare normalized header strings against the catalogued line-field list.

criteria.description: `Comparison` 上的所有实时用户输入字段在交付的模板中均为空白。
criteria.evidence: 编目可编辑单元格中的值。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查控制输入、基本原理输入和所有12行输入字段；格式和验证可以保留，但用户输入单元格中不得有任何值或公式。

original.criterion: All live user-entry fields on `Comparison` are blank in the delivered template.
original.evidence: Values in the catalogued editable cells.
original.grader_hint: Check control inputs, rationale input and all 12 line-entry fields; formatting and validations may remain, but there must be no values or formulas in user-entry cells.

criteria.description: 对于包含的完整产品线，所需的竞争对手箱数等于请求的单位数除以竞争对手箱数，向上舍入为整个箱数。
criteria.evidence: 竞争对手案例所需的公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查配方并用非多重量进行测试；排除或不完整的行应显示空白。

original.criterion: For an included complete line, Competitor Cases Required equals the requested units divided by competitor case pack, rounded upward to a whole case.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formulas and test with non-multiple quantities; excluded or incomplete rows should display blank.

criteria.description: 竞争对手交付的单位数等于竞争对手所需箱数乘以竞争对手箱包数。
criteria.evidence: 竞争对手交付单位公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪所有行公式中的同一行引用。

original.criterion: Competitor Delivered Units equals Competitor Cases Required multiplied by Competitor Case Pack.
original.grader_hint: Trace same-row references across all line formulas.

criteria.description: 竞争对手总金额等于竞争对手所需箱数乘以竞争对手箱价格。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪公式先例并验证排除的行没有贡献。

original.criterion: Competitor Gross equals Competitor Cases Required multiplied by Competitor Case Price.
original.grader_hint: Trace formula precedents and verify excluded lines do not contribute.

criteria.description: 竞争对手条款费率是从引用的条款和条款政策中获得的，而不是输入到每个计算行中。
criteria.evidence: 条款利率公式和政策单元。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认额度条款利率参考受控保单利率和赚取状态选择。

original.criterion: Competitor Terms Rate is obtained from the quoted terms and terms policy rather than typed into each calculated line.
original.grader_hint: Confirm line terms rates reference the controlled policy rate and earned-status choice.

criteria.description: 竞争对手条款积分等于竞争对手总金额乘以条款标记为已赢得条款时适用的条款费率。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试“是”行并将计算出的信用与保单利率的总乘积进行比较。

original.criterion: Competitor Terms Credit equals Competitor Gross multiplied by the applicable terms rate when terms are marked earned.
original.grader_hint: Test a YES line and compare the calculated credit with gross times the policy rate.

criteria.description: 当条款被标记为未获得时，竞争对手条款信用为零。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试完整的 NO 行并验证是否未识别即时付款信用。

original.criterion: Competitor Terms Credit equals zero when terms are marked not earned.
original.grader_hint: Test a complete NO line and verify no prompt-payment credit is recognized.

criteria.description: 竞争对手运费份额仅在包含的线路中分配计算出的竞争对手运费总额。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪分配分母并验证排除行和空行没有收到份额。

original.criterion: Competitor Freight Share allocates the calculated competitor freight total only among included lines.
original.grader_hint: Trace allocation denominators and verify excluded and blank lines receive no share.

criteria.description: 所含航线的竞争对手运费份额总和等于竞争对手的运费总额，误差范围在 ±$0.01 范围内。
criteria.evidence: 线路分配和汇总运费总额。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用全精度计算总和并与汇总总数进行比较。

original.criterion: The sum of Competitor Freight Share across included lines equals the competitor freight total within ±$0.01.
original.evidence: Line allocations and summary freight total.
original.grader_hint: Calculate the sum using full precision and compare with the summary total.

criteria.description: 竞争对手净交付总额等于竞争对手毛额减去竞争对手条款信用额加上竞争对手运费份额。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查同一行公式引用并使用非零项和运费进行测试。

original.criterion: Competitor Net Delivered Total equals Competitor Gross minus Competitor Terms Credit plus Competitor Freight Share.
original.grader_hint: Inspect same-row formula references and test with nonzero terms and freight.

criteria.description: 竞争对手交付的单位成本等于竞争对手净交付总量除以竞争对手交付的单位。
criteria.evidence: 竞争对手的单位成本公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试交付数量超过要求数量的生产线。

original.criterion: Competitor Delivered Unit Cost equals Competitor Net Delivered Total divided by Competitor Delivered Units.
original.grader_hint: Test a line where delivered quantity exceeds requested quantity.

criteria.description: 所需的 Stonebridge 包等于请求的单位除以 Stonebridge 包数量，向上舍入为整包。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用并非精确包装倍数的请求数量进行测试。

original.criterion: Stonebridge Packs Required equals requested units divided by Stonebridge Pack Quantity, rounded upward to a whole pack.
original.grader_hint: Test with a requested quantity that is not an exact pack multiple.

criteria.description: Stonebridge 交付单位等于 Stonebridge 所需包数乘以 Stonebridge 包数量。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪同一行引用。

original.criterion: Stonebridge Delivered Units equals Stonebridge Packs Required multiplied by Stonebridge Pack Quantity.
original.grader_hint: Trace same-row references.

criteria.description: Stonebridge 总金额等于 Stonebridge 所需包数乘以 Stonebridge 包价格。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪同一行引用并验证排除的行是否被忽略。

original.criterion: Stonebridge Gross equals Stonebridge Packs Required multiplied by Stonebridge Pack Price.
original.grader_hint: Trace same-row references and verify excluded lines are ignored.

criteria.description: Stonebridge Freight Share 仅在包含的线路中分配计算出的 Stonebridge 货运总额。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查分配分母并使用包含和排除的行进行测试。

original.criterion: Stonebridge Freight Share allocates the calculated Stonebridge freight total only among included lines.
original.grader_hint: Inspect allocation denominator and test with included and excluded lines.

criteria.description: 所含线路的 Stonebridge 货运份额总和等于 ±$0.01 范围内的 Stonebridge 货运总额。
criteria.evidence: 线路分配和汇总运费总额。
criteria.grader_hint: 以全精度对分配求和并与摘要进行比较。

original.criterion: The sum of Stonebridge Freight Share across included lines equals the Stonebridge freight total within ±$0.01.
original.evidence: Line allocations and summary freight total.
original.grader_hint: Sum the allocations at full precision and compare with the summary.

criteria.description: Stonebridge 净交付总额等于 Stonebridge 总金额加上 Stonebridge 货运份额，不适用任何竞争对手的信用条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪先例并验证公式不依赖于竞争对手的条款状态或费率。

original.criterion: Stonebridge Net Delivered Total equals Stonebridge Gross plus Stonebridge Freight Share, with no competitor terms credit applied.
original.grader_hint: Trace precedents and verify the formula has no dependency on competitor terms status or rate.

criteria.description: Stonebridge 交付单位成本等于 Stonebridge 净交付总量除以 Stonebridge 交付单位。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试非多件包装数量并进行完全精确的比较。

original.criterion: Stonebridge Delivered Unit Cost equals Stonebridge Net Delivered Total divided by Stonebridge Delivered Units.
original.grader_hint: Test a non-multiple pack quantity and compare at full precision.

criteria.description: 单位差异等于 Stonebridge 交付的单位成本减去竞争对手交付的单位成本。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪同一行引用并验证符号约定。

original.criterion: Unit Difference equals Stonebridge Delivered Unit Cost minus Competitor Delivered Unit Cost.
original.grader_hint: Trace same-row references and verify the sign convention.

criteria.description: 单位差异百分比等于单位差异除以竞争对手交付的单位成本。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查公式先例并验证显示的百分比保留基本精度。

original.criterion: Unit Difference Percent equals Unit Difference divided by Competitor Delivered Unit Cost.
original.grader_hint: Inspect formula precedents and verify the displayed percentage retains underlying precision.

criteria.description: 结果行使用编目标签和单位差异符号将 Stonebridge 分类为较低、等于或较高。
criteria.evidence: 结果公式和允许的输出标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试负差异、零差异和正差异，并将文本与目录进行比较。

original.criterion: The line Result classifies Stonebridge as lower, equal or higher using the catalogued labels and the sign of Unit Difference.
original.evidence: Result formulas and allowed output labels.
original.grader_hint: Test negative, zero and positive differences and compare the text with the catalog.

criteria.description: 活动行计数等于标记为 `YES` 的行数，其中包含所需的最少比较输入。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试包括完整行、包括不完整行和排除完整行。

original.criterion: The active-line count equals the number of lines marked `YES` that contain the minimum required comparison inputs.
original.grader_hint: Test included complete, included incomplete and excluded complete rows.

criteria.description: 请求的总单位数仅等于活动包含行的请求单位数的总和。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查聚合条件并测试排除的填充行。

original.criterion: Total Requested Units equals the sum of requested units for active included lines only.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the aggregation condition and test an excluded populated line.

criteria.description: 竞争对手总金额等于包含的行级别竞争对手总金额的总和。
criteria.grader_hint: 将汇总公式与活动行范围进行比较。

original.criterion: Competitor Gross Summary equals the sum of included line-level Competitor Gross amounts.
original.grader_hint: Compare the summary formula with the active line range.

criteria.description: 竞争对手条款摘要等于所包含的行级别竞争对手条款积分的总和。
criteria.grader_hint: 将摘要与行级学分进行比较。

original.criterion: Competitor Terms Summary equals the sum of included line-level Competitor Terms Credits.
original.grader_hint: Compare the summary with line-level credits.

criteria.description: 竞争对手净摘要等于竞争对手毛额减去条款加上运费。
criteria.evidence: 竞争对手净值汇总公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪摘要引用而不是依赖显示的值。

original.criterion: Competitor Net Summary equals competitor gross less terms plus freight.
original.grader_hint: Trace summary references rather than relying on displayed values.

criteria.description: Stonebridge 总金额等于包含的行级别 Stonebridge 总金额的总和。
criteria.grader_hint: 将聚合与活动线路范围进行比较。

original.criterion: Stonebridge Gross Summary equals the sum of included line-level Stonebridge Gross amounts.
original.grader_hint: Compare the aggregation with the active line range.

criteria.description: Stonebridge 净摘要等于 Stonebridge 毛额加上 Stonebridge 运费。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪汇总公式并验证它没有项推导。

original.criterion: Stonebridge Net Summary equals Stonebridge gross plus Stonebridge freight.
original.grader_hint: Trace the summary formula and verify it has no terms deduction.

criteria.description: `Method & QA` 中显示的总请求单位是到`Comparison` 总数的直接链接或由公式导出的链接，而不是单独输入的常量。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查审查区域单元格并追踪比较总计；更改测试输入并确认两个显示一致。

original.criterion: The Total Requested Units shown in `Method & QA` is a direct or formula-derived link to the `Comparison` total, not a separately entered constant.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the review-area cell and trace it to the Comparison total; change test inputs and confirm both displays agree.

criteria.description: 评论区域中显示的运费基础与 `Comparison` 上的实时选择相关联。
criteria.grader_hint: 更改比较选择并重新计算；审阅区域显示必须跟随。

original.criterion: The Freight Basis shown in the review area is linked to the live selection on `Comparison`.
original.grader_hint: Change the Comparison selection and recalculate; the review-area display must follow.

criteria.description: 评论区域中显示的目的地管辖区与 `Comparison` 上的实时选择相关联。
criteria.grader_hint: 将 PA 更改为 NJ 并重新计算；审阅区域显示必须更新。

original.criterion: The Destination Jurisdiction shown in the review area is linked to the live selection on `Comparison`.
original.grader_hint: Change PA to NJ and recalculate; the review-area display must update.

criteria.description: 在`QUOTE_ORDER`下，各方的运费测试使用该方计算的包含行报价小计。
criteria.grader_hint: 选择QUOTE_ORDER并追踪竞争对手和Stonebridge的阈值测试量。

original.criterion: Under `QUOTE_ORDER`, each party’s freight test uses that party’s calculated included-line quote subtotal.
original.grader_hint: Select QUOTE_ORDER and trace the threshold-test amount for both competitor and Stonebridge.

criteria.description: 在`REPLENISHMENT_ORDER`下，各方的运费测试使用该方用户输入的代表性补货小计。
criteria.grader_hint: 选择 REPLENISHMENT_ORDER 并验证运费计算是否切换到两个代表订单输入。

original.criterion: Under `REPLENISHMENT_ORDER`, each party’s freight test uses that party’s user-entered representative replenishment subtotal.
original.grader_hint: Select REPLENISHMENT_ORDER and verify the freight calculations switch to the two representative-order inputs.

criteria.description: 选择 PA 后，竞争对手和 Stonebridge 运费计算将应用交付政策中的 PA 阈值和费用。
criteria.evidence: 依赖于司法管辖区的运费公式和受控的政策值。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试紧邻每个 PA 阈值的值并与提供的策略进行比较。

original.criterion: When PA is selected, competitor and Stonebridge freight calculations apply the PA thresholds and charges from the delivery policy.
original.evidence: Jurisdiction-dependent freight formulas and controlled policy values.
original.grader_hint: Test values immediately below and at each PA threshold and compare with the supplied policy.

criteria.description: 选择新泽西州后，竞争对手和 Stonebridge 的运费计算将应用送货政策中的新泽西州阈值、费用和特定司法管辖区的处理方式。
criteria.evidence: 依赖于司法管辖区的运费公式和受控的政策值。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试紧邻新泽西州阈值以下和每个新泽西州阈值的值，包括政策的新泽西州特定组成部分。

original.criterion: When NJ is selected, competitor and Stonebridge freight calculations apply the NJ thresholds, charges and jurisdiction-specific treatment from the delivery policy.
original.evidence: Jurisdiction-dependent freight formulas and controlled policy values.
original.grader_hint: Test values immediately below and at each NJ threshold, including the policy’s NJ-specific component.

criteria.description: 运费阈值被视为满足适用政策中规定的最低限度。
criteria.evidence: 运费公式中的边界算子。
criteria.grader_hint: 精确测试阈值减去$0.01，并精确测试每个相关计划的阈值。

original.criterion: A freight threshold is treated as satisfied at the exact minimum stated in the applicable policy.
original.grader_hint: Test exactly threshold minus $0.01 and exactly threshold for each relevant schedule.

criteria.description: 仅当该行被标记为赢得并且报价提供折扣时，才会识别竞争对手的即时付款折扣。
criteria.evidence: 术语公式和引用策略控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪对赢得的选择和受控报价条款的依赖性。

original.criterion: The competitor prompt-payment discount is recognized only when the line is marked earned and the quote provides the discount.
original.grader_hint: Trace dependencies to both the earned choice and the controlled quote terms.

criteria.description: Stonebridge 的计算不会产生 Stonebridge 政策不提供的即时付款折扣。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索 Stonebridge 公式以了解术语费率依赖性并测试竞争对手的术语选择。

original.criterion: Stonebridge calculations do not create a prompt-payment discount that Stonebridge’s policy does not offer.
original.grader_hint: Search Stonebridge formulas for terms-rate dependencies and test competitor terms choices.

criteria.description: `Method & QA` 选项卡包含控制目录中命名的所有四个键控验证案例。
criteria.grader_hint: 将案例 ID 和名称与目录准确比较。

original.criterion: The `Method & QA` tab contains all four keyed verification cases named in the control catalog.
original.grader_hint: Compare the case IDs and names exactly with the catalog.

criteria.description: 每个键控验证案例都包含重现其预期结果所需的完整编目输入集。
criteria.grader_hint: 对于每种情况，将填充的输入字段与控制目录进行比较，并确认未遗漏任何必需的输入。

original.criterion: Each keyed verification case includes the complete catalogued input set needed to reproduce its expected result.
original.grader_hint: For each case, compare populated input fields with the control catalog and confirm no required input is omitted.

criteria.description: 每个钥匙箱显示的预期输出与控制目录一致，货币单位为±$0.01，数量单位为±0.01。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用规定的容差将存储的预期输出与提供的案例密钥进行比较。

original.criterion: Each keyed case’s displayed expected outputs agree with the control catalog within ±$0.01 for currency and ±0.01 unit for quantities.
original.grader_hint: Compare the stored expected outputs to the supplied case key using the stated tolerances.

criteria.description: 每个键控案例的实际输出单元格都包含练习工作簿规范化逻辑的公式，而不是复制的预期常量。
criteria.evidence: QA 实际单元格和公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查单元格类型并跟踪公式以共享策略控制或等效计算逻辑。

original.criterion: Each keyed case’s Actual output cells contain formulas that exercise the workbook’s normalization logic rather than copied expected constants.
original.grader_hint: Inspect cell types and trace formulas to shared policy controls or equivalent calculation logic.

criteria.description: 仅当每个单独的 QA 断言的实际值和预期值在编目公差范围内一致时，才会显示“通过”。
criteria.grader_hint: 扰动一个期望值并重新计算以验证相应的状态更改为 FAIL。

original.criterion: Each individual QA assertion displays PASS only when its Actual and Expected values agree within the catalogued tolerance.
original.grader_hint: Perturb one expected value and recalculate to verify the corresponding status changes to FAIL.

criteria.description: 仅当每个单独的键控断言都通过时，整体 QA 状态才会显示 PASS。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪整个公式到所有断言状态并强制一个失败。

original.criterion: The overall QA status displays PASS only when every individual keyed assertion passes.
original.grader_hint: Trace the overall formula to all assertion statuses and force one failure.

criteria.description: 包装舍入钥匙盒可验证两个报价的向上舍入和交付单位超额。
criteria.evidence: 包舍入案例输入、预期输出和断言。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认箱子使用非多个数量，并单独检查所需的包装和交付的单位。

original.criterion: The pack-rounding keyed case verifies upward rounding and delivered-unit overage for both offers.
original.evidence: Pack-rounding case inputs, expected outputs and assertions.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the case uses non-multiple quantities and separately checks required packs and delivered units.

criteria.description: 货运边界键控箱验证紧邻免费货运阈值以下和处于免费货运阈值的行为。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认边界两侧都有代表并独立主张。

original.criterion: The freight-boundary keyed case verifies behavior immediately below and at a free-freight threshold.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both sides of the boundary are represented and independently asserted.

criteria.description: 司法管辖区关键案例表明，相同的商业投入可能会产生不同的宾夕法尼亚州和新泽西州交付结果。
criteria.evidence: 管辖权案例和预期产出。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认案件改变管辖权，同时保持编目非管辖权输入不变。

original.criterion: The jurisdiction keyed case demonstrates that identical commercial inputs can produce different PA and NJ delivery results.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the case changes jurisdiction while holding the catalogued non-jurisdiction inputs constant.

criteria.description: 术语 keyed case 可验证竞争对手折扣的赚取和非赚取待遇。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认“是”和“否”结果均以相同的适用报价条款表示。

original.criterion: The terms keyed case verifies both earned and not-earned treatment for the competitor discount.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both YES and NO outcomes are represented with the same applicable quote terms.

criteria.description: 该方法指南将 `QUOTE_ORDER` 和 `REPLENISHMENT_ORDER` 解释为可防御的货运视图，包括每种方法何时有用以及每种方法的局限性。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找一个平衡的解释，不要将任何一种观点都视为普遍强制性的。

original.criterion: The method guide explains both `QUOTE_ORDER` and `REPLENISHMENT_ORDER` as defensible freight views, including when each is useful and the limitation of each.
original.grader_hint: Look for a balanced explanation that does not present either view as universally mandatory.

criteria.description: 该指南为审查者提供了判断所选运费基础和书面理由是否适合商业情况的可用标准。
criteria.evidence: 审稿人指导和理由标准。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查者应该能够在没有外部培训的情况下区分受支持的选择和任意选择。

original.criterion: The guide gives a reviewer usable criteria for judging whether the selected freight basis and written rationale fit the commercial situation.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should be able to distinguish a supported choice from an arbitrary choice without outside training.

criteria.description: 公式驱动的完成分数或检查表评估所有编目审阅控制，而不依赖于隐藏的手动标记。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪每个评分控制以观察可观察的工作簿输入或 QA 状态，并将控制与目录进行比较。

original.criterion: A formula-driven completion score or checklist evaluates all catalogued review controls without depending on hidden manual marks.
original.grader_hint: Trace each scored control to observable workbook inputs or QA statuses and compare the controls with the catalog.

criteria.description: 现场指南充分定义了每个实时输入和计算输出，以便订单台用户正确输入比较。
criteria.evidence: 方法和 QA 的字段定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 对每个字段类别进行采样，包括包装、请求与交付的单位、运费基础、条款和结果标志。

original.criterion: The field guide defines every live input and calculated output sufficiently for an order-desk user to enter a comparison correctly.
original.grader_hint: Sample every field category, including packs, requested versus delivered units, freight basis, terms and result sign.

criteria.description: 方法和策略映射按文件名识别所有六个提供的引用，并说明每个引用的控制内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 在显示的单元格文本中搜索每个确切的文件名，并查看相邻的控件说明。

original.criterion: The method and policy map identify all six supplied references by filename and state what each controls.
original.grader_hint: Search displayed cell text for each exact filename and review the adjacent control description.

criteria.description: 理由输入字段已解锁，其大小明显适合有意义的解释，并链接或显示在审阅区域中。
criteria.evidence: 单元保护、几何形状和跨表显示的基本原理。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认它接受用户文本，不是单字符控件，并且可以通过方法和 QA 进行审查。

original.criterion: The rationale entry field is unlocked, visibly sized for a meaningful explanation and linked or displayed in the review area.
original.evidence: Rationale cell protection, geometry and cross-sheet display.
original.grader_hint: Confirm it accepts user text, is not a one-character control and can be reviewed from Method & QA.

criteria.description: 条件格式使用编目含义区分较低、相等和较高的行结果，而不更改存储的结果值。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查规则公式和适用范围，然后测试所有三个结果状态。

original.criterion: Conditional formatting distinguishes lower, equal and higher line results using the catalogued meaning without changing the stored result values.
original.grader_hint: Inspect rule formulas and applies-to ranges, then test all three result states.

criteria.description: 未使用或不完整的比较线显示空白，而不是除法错误、零值伪结果或误导性分类。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算交付的空白模板并部分填充行；检查所有相关输出字段。

original.criterion: Unused or incomplete comparison lines display blanks rather than division errors, zero-value pseudo-results or misleading classifications.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the delivered blank template and partially populate lines; inspect all dependent output fields.

criteria.description: 标记为 `NO` 的填充行对数量、货币摘要、货运分配或总体比较结果没有任何贡献。
criteria.evidence: 跨行和汇总公式包含条件逻辑。
criteria.grader_hint: 填充两行完整的行，排除一行并比较排除前后的每个相关总数。

original.criterion: A populated line marked `NO` contributes nothing to quantities, monetary summaries, freight allocations or overall comparison results.
original.evidence: Include-condition logic across line and summary formulas.
original.grader_hint: Populate two complete lines, exclude one and compare every relevant total before and after exclusion.

criteria.description: 该工作簿不包含宏、外部工作簿链接、外部数据连接或易失性 Web 服务公式。
criteria.evidence: OOXML 包、关系、连接和公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查外部路径、WEBSERVICE 或类似调用的 VBA 部件、外部链接、连接和公式。

original.criterion: The workbook contains no macros, external workbook links, external data connections or volatile web-service formulas.
original.evidence: OOXML package, relationships, connections and formulas.
original.grader_hint: Inspect VBA parts, externalLinks, connections and formulas for external paths, WEBSERVICE or similar calls.

criteria.description: 销售、定价或订单台审核员无需单独培训即可浏览工作簿、确定要输入的内容、了解商业调整并做出报价审核决策。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用一个关键场景作为指导进行冷审查；评估清晰度、可编辑性、决策的突出性以及是否存在模糊或阻碍性的控制。

spec.professional_context: Stonebridge Health Network’s wholesale facilities-supply desk is preparing a defensible response to a long-standing account’s competing PVF offer. Sales, order desk, pricing and review staff need one reusable workbook that exposes the commercial adjustments and preserves the chosen freight judgment.
difficulty_sources: Choosing and documenting one of two defensible freight-normalization bases without silently forcing the decision
Converting different case and pack offers to comparable delivered-unit economics through dependent calculations
Applying distinct Pennsylvania and New Jersey delivery schedules and threshold boundaries
Separating blank user inputs from protected calculated outputs while retaining a populated internal QA key
Maintaining formula-driven freight allocations, summaries and cross-sheet agreement
Designing a reusable workbook that remains understandable to sales, pricing and order-desk reviewers

authoring_plan.design_intent: Create a blank live comparison instrument whose quote-entry cells remain empty while a separate method and QA tab contains controlled guidance, a reviewer scoring guide, and fully populated verification cases with expected answers. The instrument must expose rather than conceal the choice between quote-order and replenishment-order freight economics.

Foxhollow_competitor_quote.pdf.content: A complete synthetic competitor PVF quote for Foxhollow Practice, including several case-priced lines, case-pack quantities, destination, a free-freight minimum higher than Stonebridge's, a below-minimum freight charge and 2/10 net 30 terms.
Foxhollow_competitor_quote.pdf.imperfections: No contradictions or missing facts. The commercial ambiguity comes from whether this small contested quote or a representative replenishment order is the fair freight basis.

Stonebridge_price_export.xlsx.content: Synthetic Stonebridge SKU records corresponding to the quoted competitor products, with selling UOM, pack quantity and pack price.
Stonebridge_price_export.xlsx.imperfections: Pack sizes differ from competitor case packs, requiring upward pack rounding and delivered-quantity normalization.

PA_NJ_delivery_policy.pdf.content: Separate Pennsylvania and New Jersey delivery schedules for competitor and Stonebridge, each with explicit free-freight thresholds, below-threshold charges, inclusive threshold language and one NJ-specific delivery component.
PA_NJ_delivery_policy.pdf.imperfections: None; policy variation across jurisdictions creates the transformation requirement.

customer_terms_policy.docx.content: Policy stating that a competitor prompt-payment discount is recognized only when documented and reasonably expected to be earned; Stonebridge offers no comparable prompt-payment discount for this account.
customer_terms_policy.docx.imperfections: Eligibility remains a bounded user judgment that must be made visible.

PVF_item_crosswalk.xlsx.content: Competitor item to Stonebridge SKU mappings, descriptions and approved comparison UOM values for the quoted PVF products.
PVF_item_crosswalk.xlsx.imperfections: Equivalent items use different pack quantities but have compatible comparison units.

Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx.content: Exact tab names, labels, line-table field vocabulary, 12-line capacity, validation values, named ranges, field definitions, result labels, review controls, tolerance rules and four complete keyed verification cases.
Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx.imperfections: None. It carries every arbitrary local convention required by the rubric.

sheets.name: Comparison
sheets.purpose: Blank live entry, calculations, visible freight-basis decision and commercial summary.

validations.Comparison UOM: Exact approved list supplied in Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx

formula_rules.active_line: A line is active only when Include is YES and the minimum numeric and identifier inputs required for both offers are complete.
formula_rules.competitor_delivered_units: Competitor Cases Required * Competitor Case Pack.
formula_rules.competitor_gross: Competitor Cases Required * Competitor Case Price.
formula_rules.competitor_terms_rate: Use the controlled quoted discount rate only when Competitor Terms Earned is YES; otherwise zero.
formula_rules.stonebridge_delivered_units: Stonebridge Packs Required * Stonebridge Pack Quantity.
formula_rules.stonebridge_gross: Stonebridge Packs Required * Stonebridge Pack Price.
formula_rules.freight_basis_quote_order: Test each party's included-line calculated gross subtotal against that party's threshold for the selected jurisdiction.
formula_rules.freight_basis_replenishment_order: Test each party's entered representative replenishment subtotal against that party's threshold for the selected jurisdiction.
formula_rules.freight_boundary: A subtotal equal to the stated threshold qualifies for free freight.
formula_rules.freight_allocation: Allocate each party's freight total across active lines in proportion to that party's line gross. Allocations must sum to the corresponding freight total; preserve underlying precision and display currency to two decimals.
formula_rules.competitor_net: Competitor Gross - Competitor Terms Credit + Competitor Freight Share.
formula_rules.stonebridge_net: Stonebridge Gross + Stonebridge Freight Share. Never apply the competitor discount to Stonebridge.
formula_rules.delivered_unit_cost: Net Delivered Total / Delivered Units for the corresponding party.
formula_rules.unit_difference: Stonebridge Delivered Unit Cost - Competitor Delivered Unit Cost.
formula_rules.unit_difference_percent: Unit Difference / Competitor Delivered Unit Cost.
formula_rules.result: Use the exact catalogued lower/equal/higher labels based on the sign of Unit Difference.
formula_rules.blank_handling: Return blank for inactive or incomplete line outputs; do not emit errors, zeros masquerading as results or classifications.
formula_rules.exclusion: A populated line marked NO has no effect on any line allocation, quantity, summary or result.

sheets.name: Method & QA
sheets.purpose: Self-contained method guide, policy map, field guide, linked review summary, scoring guide, controlled lists and keyed verification cases.
required_guidance: Explain quote-order economics and replenishment-order economics as distinct defensible views.
State benefits and limitations of each view without declaring a universal winner.
Explain pack rounding, delivered-unit overage, terms eligibility, jurisdiction selection, freight allocation and result sign.
Define every input and output field.
Map all six exact reference filenames to the controls they govern.
Provide criteria for reviewer acceptance of the selected freight basis and rationale.
sheets.scoring_guide: Use formula-driven review controls from the catalog, including required decision fields, rationale, active lines, compatible UOM, complete commercial inputs and passing QA status.
keyed_cases: Pack rounding and delivered-unit overage for both offers
Immediately below versus exactly at a free-freight threshold
PA versus NJ with otherwise identical commercial inputs
Competitor terms marked earned versus not earned
sheets.qa_logic: Populate the exact case inputs and expected outputs from the control catalog. Actual output cells must contain live formulas. Each assertion compares Actual with Expected using catalogued tolerances, and the overall status is PASS only when every assertion passes.

workbook_structure.cross_sheet_quantity: Total Requested Units is calculated once from active Comparison lines and displayed on Method & QA through a direct cross-sheet formula or a defined name resolving to that formula. It must never be separately entered.
workbook_structure.input_output_separation: All live user-entry cells are blank, visibly identified and unlocked. All live calculations are formula cells, visibly distinct and locked. Keyed constants on Method & QA are labeled as controlled test inputs or expected values so they cannot be mistaken for live quote entries.
workbook_structure.protection: Enable sheet protection with unlocked entry cells selectable and editable. Lock formulas, policy constants, controlled lists, expected answers and scoring formulas.
workbook_structure.print_and_navigation: Both sheets use US letter landscape and fit to one page wide. Comparison repeats its line header row, freezes the control and header area, and maintains readable print titles and print areas.
workbook_structure.conditional_formatting: Apply catalog-consistent formatting to lower, equal and higher Result values and to QA PASS/FAIL statuses. Formatting changes appearance only, not stored output text.
prohibited_structure: Pasted constants in live computed fields
Prefilled values in live quote-entry cells

verification.offline_build: Use openpyxl to construct and introspect the workbook, and an installed office engine if available to recalculate formulas and render print previews.
formula_tests: Non-multiple competitor and Stonebridge pack quantities
Freight subtotals below, equal to and above each jurisdictional threshold
Included, excluded, blank and partially completed lines
Allocation sums and cross-sheet quantity linkage
verification.intended_verdict: A passing workbook is blank where users enter live quote data, keyed where future editors verify the tool, formula-driven throughout, explicit about the freight judgment and internally consistent under every supplied policy case.

title_original: artifact spec wholesale pvf normalization worksheet
original_instruction:
You are the order clerk supporting Stonebridge Health Network’s wholesale facilities-supply desk. Foxhollow Practice, a twelve-year account, has put a competitor’s pipe, valve and fitting program in front of Genevieve Fairbairn and asked Stonebridge to match it. Genevieve wants the comparison settled before Petra Egwuatu’s Friday 2:00 p.m. quote review, but Theo Lindqvist has challenged whether competitor freight belongs in the comparison at all. Build a reusable blank workbook that lets the desk enter each contested item and see the competitor and Stonebridge offers on the same delivered per-unit basis, with pack conversion, overage, terms, freight and the resulting difference visible rather than buried. Use `Foxhollow_competitor_quote.pdf` to understand the competing offer, `Stonebridge_price_export.xlsx` for Stonebridge pricing conventions, `PA_NJ_delivery_policy.pdf` for the Pennsylvania and New Jersey delivery rules, `customer_terms_policy.docx` for discount treatment, `PVF_item_crosswalk.xlsx` for item and unit conventions, and `Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx` for the workbook vocabulary, tab names, allowed choices and built-in verification cases. There are two defensible freight views: economics of this quote or economics of a representative replenishment order. The workbook must require the user to choose one, make the choice prominent, carry it consistently through the calculations and give the reviewer enough guidance to assess the rationale; do not silently force one view. Keep the quote-entry area blank, clearly distinguish editable entries from calculated results, and include a self-contained method guide, scoring guide and keyed verification area so Ilse Khouri can confirm the workbook still calculates correctly after future edits. The total requested comparison quantity shown in the working area and review area must remain linked and agree. The workbook will be reviewed electronically and occasionally printed, so use letter landscape, one page wide, with repeating line headers where needed. Protect formulas without preventing normal entry, suppress misleading errors on unused lines, and do not use macros or external links. Save the finished file as `competitive_price_normalization.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory, using exactly that filename.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Foxhollow_competitor_quote.pdf` — Competitor PVF quote showing case packs, quoted prices, freight minimum, freight charge, payment terms and destination details.
- `references/Stonebridge_price_export.xlsx` — Stonebridge item, pack, price and selling-unit conventions for the contested products.
- `references/PA_NJ_delivery_policy.pdf` — Pennsylvania and New Jersey freight thresholds, charges and jurisdiction-specific delivery treatment.
- `references/customer_terms_policy.docx` — Policy for recognizing competitor prompt-payment discounts and Stonebridge customer terms.
- `references/PVF_item_crosswalk.xlsx` — Cross-reference of competitor items, Stonebridge SKUs and approved comparison units.
- `references/Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx` — Local workbook vocabulary, required tab names, validation choices, field definitions, named-range conventions and keyed verification cases.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `competitive_price_normalization.xlsx` — Reusable blank competitive PVF price-normalization workbook with live calculations, decision controls, method guidance and a keyed verification area. (Create an XLSX workbook without macros or external links. Use the tab names, validation values, field vocabulary and verification cases supplied in Normalization_control_catalog.xlsx. Keep the live quote-entry fields blank, retain the keyed QA content, distinguish and protect computed cells, link the total requested quantity across the working and review areas, and configure both tabs for letter-landscape printing at one page wide.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
